grammar: 副词短语，表示“此刻”或“立刻”，常用于说明当前情况或催促。
collocations: right now；do it right now
commonMistake: right now 表示现在/马上；at the moment 多强调当前状态。

example.english: I can't talk right now; I'm on the bus.
example.chinese: 我现在不能说话，我在公交车上。

application.prompt: The phone is ringing. Please answer it ___. (right now / last year)
application.solution: right now。解析：电话正在响，应用 right now 表示立刻。

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: at, on and in (time)

grammar: 可作动词“骑、乘”，也可作名词“旅程”；动词过去式和过去分词为 rode, ridden。
collocations: ride a bike；ride a bus；a bus ride
commonMistake: 表示乘坐自行车或马通常用 ride；ride 后接交通工具时一般不加 on。

example.english: Mia rides her bike to school every day.
example.chinese: 米娅每天骑自行车上学。

application.prompt: Leo goes to school on two wheels. He ___ his bike. (rides / drives)
application.solution: rides。解析：骑自行车用 ride；主语 Leo 是第三人称单数，谓语加 -s。

grammar: 可数名词，表示某个时刻或片刻；常见表达为 at the moment 和 wait a moment。
collocations: at the moment；for a moment；wait a moment
commonMistake: moment 作可数名词，单数前通常需要限定词，如 a moment。

example.english: Please wait a moment while I call Beth.
example.chinese: 我给贝丝打电话时，请稍等片刻。

application.prompt: Please wait ___ while I find the message. (a moment / moment)
application.solution: a moment。解析：moment 是单数可数名词，前面需要 a。

grammar: 介词短语，意为“此刻、目前”；描述正在发生的动作时常与现在进行时连用。
collocations: at the moment；busy at the moment
commonMistake: at the moment 前用 at；不要误写成 in the moment 来表达一般的“目前”。

example.english: Dad is driving at the moment, so please call later.
example.chinese: 爸爸此刻正在开车，请晚些时候再打。

application.prompt: Mum can't answer; she ___ dinner at the moment. (is making / makes yesterday)
application.solution: is making。解析：at the moment 表示此刻正在进行，使用现在进行时。

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: present simple and present continuous

grammar: 短语动词，表示“从事、努力完成”；on 后接名词或代词。
collocations: work on a project；work on homework；work on it
commonMistake: on 是介词，后接名词或代词；代词放在 on 后，如 work on it。

example.english: I am working on a message for my coach.
example.chinese: 我正在为教练写一条留言。

application.prompt: Nina is doing her science project now. She is ___ it. (working on / working at)
application.solution: working on。解析：work on sth 表示从事或努力完成某事。

grammar: 可数名词，表示“龙”；单数前可用 a，复数为 dragons。
collocations: a dragon boat；a dragon story；a Chinese dragon
commonMistake: dragon 是普通可数名词；Dragon Boat Festival 中各主要单词首字母大写。

example.english: The children made a paper dragon for the festival.
example.chinese: 孩子们为节日做了一条纸龙。

application.prompt: There is one long, imaginary animal on the poster. It is a ___. (dragon / message)
application.solution: dragon。解析：龙是 dragon。

grammar: 可数名词，表示节日或庆典；具体节日名称通常首字母大写。
collocations: a music festival；a traditional festival；the Dragon Boat Festival
commonMistake: festival 是可数名词，单数前通常加 a/an 或 the；节日专名注意大写。

example.english: Our school holds a music festival in May.
example.chinese: 我们学校五月举办一场音乐节。

application.prompt: We enjoy songs and food at the school ___. (festival / sunshine)
application.solution: festival。解析：学校举办的庆祝活动是 festival。

grammar: 动词可表示“拿着、握住”或“举行”；过去式和过去分词都是 held。
collocations: hold a phone；hold a meeting；hold an event
commonMistake: hold 的过去式是 held，不是 holded；举行活动也可用 hold。

example.english: Please hold the phone with both hands.
example.chinese: 请用双手拿着手机。

application.prompt: Yesterday the club ___ a small race. (held / holded)
application.solution: held。解析：hold 的过去式为 held。

grammar: 短语动词，可表示电话中“别挂断”，也可表示“稍等”。
collocations: Hold on, please.；hold on a minute
commonMistake: 电话中 hold on 是请对方等待；礼貌表达可说 Hold on, please.。

example.english: Hold on, please. I'll get Dad.
example.chinese: 请稍等，我去叫爸爸。

application.prompt: You need to find the phone number before replying on a call. Say: “___, please.”
application.solution: Hold on。解析：电话中请对方稍等可说 Hold on, please.。

grammar: 可数名词，表示人的嗓音；声音的大小或语气可用形容词修饰。
collocations: a loud voice；a quiet voice；hear someone's voice
commonMistake: voice 通常指人的嗓音；表示一般环境声常用 sound。

example.english: I heard my sister's voice on the phone.
example.chinese: 我在电话里听到了姐姐的声音。

application.prompt: You recognize your friend by the sound she makes when speaking. You recognize her ___. (voice / race)
application.solution: voice。解析：人的嗓音用 voice。

grammar: 可数名词，表示比赛或竞赛；也可作动词表示快速移动或参加赛跑。
collocations: a running race；win a race；take part in a race
commonMistake: race 表示比赛时是可数名词；“参加比赛”可说 take part in a race。

example.english: Our class will have a running race on Friday.
example.chinese: 我们班星期五要举行一场跑步比赛。

application.prompt: The students run to see who is fastest. They are in a ___. (race / time zone)
application.solution: race。解析：比速度的竞赛是 race。

grammar: 可作可数名词，表示亲爱的人；也可作亲昵称呼，通常用于熟人或亲密关系。
collocations: my darling；Darling, ...
commonMistake: darling 是亲昵称呼，正式或不熟悉的交流中不宜随意称呼对方。

example.english: Darling, your message is on the table.
example.chinese: 亲爱的，你的留言在桌上。

application.prompt: Choose the suitable word for a warm family greeting: “Good morning, ___!” (darling / passenger)
application.solution: darling。解析：darling 可用于亲密家人间的亲昵称呼。

grammar: 不定代词，意为“某人”；通常作单数看待，后接单数谓语。
collocations: somebody is；somebody's message；somebody else
commonMistake: somebody 作主语时用单数谓语，如 Somebody is calling.。

example.english: Somebody is waiting outside the club.
example.chinese: 有人正在俱乐部外面等候。

application.prompt: ___ is calling you now. (Somebody / Some people)
application.solution: Somebody。解析：谓语 is 表明主语应为单数 somebody。

grammar: 情态动词，后接动词原形；可表示过去的能力，也可用于礼貌请求。
collocations: could you ...?；could swim；could help
commonMistake: could 后接动词原形，不加 to 或第三人称 -s；礼貌请求后可加 please。

example.english: Could you leave a message for Beth, please?
example.chinese: 请问你能给贝丝留个口信吗？

application.prompt: Complete the polite request: “Could you ___ me back later?” (call / to call)
application.solution: call。解析：情态动词 could 后接动词原形。

grammar: 可数名词，表示消息或口信；表示一条消息时用 a message。
collocations: send a message；get a message；leave a message
commonMistake: message 是可数名词；一条留言说 a message，不能省略冠词。

example.english: I got a message from my coach this morning.
example.chinese: 今天早上我收到教练发来的一条消息。

application.prompt: You want your teacher to know you called. You can leave a ___. (message / sunshine)
application.solution: message。解析：留口信是 leave a message。

grammar: 动词短语，表示“替别人捎个口信”；常用于电话接听场景。
collocations: take a message for sb；Can I take a message?
commonMistake: take a message 是替对方记录转达；leave a message 是来电者留下口信。

example.english: Can I take a message for your dad?
example.chinese: 我可以替你爸爸捎个口信吗？

application.prompt: You answer your friend's phone while she is away. Offer to write down the caller's words: “Can I ___?”
application.solution: take a message。解析：替不在场的人记录口信用 take a message。

grammar: 动词短语，表示“留下口信”；可用 leave a message for sb。
collocations: leave a message for sb；leave a phone message
commonMistake: 来电者留下口信是 leave a message；接听者替人捎话是 take a message。

example.english: Please leave a message for me after the beep.
example.chinese: 请在提示音后给我留个口信。

application.prompt: The person you called is not home. You decide to tell them to call you. You can ___.
application.solution: leave a message。解析：来电者留下信息用 leave a message。

grammar: 短语动词，表示“回电话”；可说 call sb back，代词宾语放在 call 与 back 之间。
collocations: call me back；call back later；call sb back
commonMistake: 代词作宾语时说 call me back，不说 call back me。

example.english: I'm in class now. I'll call you back at four.
example.chinese: 我现在在上课，四点给你回电话。

application.prompt: Rewrite with the pronoun in the correct place: “call back him” → ___
application.solution: call him back。解析：可分短语动词后接代词时，代词放在动词和副词之间。

grammar: 动词，表示用脚踢；过去式和过去分词为 kicked。
collocations: kick a ball；kick the ball into the goal
commonMistake: 表示踢某物时，kick 后直接接宾语，不需要加 to。

example.english: Sam kicked the ball into the goal.
example.chinese: 萨姆把球踢进了球门。

application.prompt: In football, players use their feet to ___ the ball. (kick / hold)
application.solution: kick。解析：用脚踢球用 kick the ball。

grammar: 感叹词，表示惊讶或赞叹；常放在句首，后面可用逗号。
collocations: Wow!；Wow, that's amazing!
commonMistake: wow 表达惊讶或赞叹；正式书面语中应谨慎使用。

example.english: Wow, your team won the race!
example.chinese: 哇，你们队赢了比赛！

application.prompt: Your friend tells you she won first place. Choose a natural response: “___, that's great!” (Wow / Slowly)
application.solution: Wow。解析：Wow 可表达惊喜和赞叹。

grammar: 可作形容词或副词，表示“在线的/在网上”；常与 be、go、shop、learn 等词搭配。
collocations: be online；go online；an online message
commonMistake: online 通常直接修饰名词或跟在 be 后，不需要加介词 in。

example.english: Our club meeting is online tonight.
example.chinese: 今晚我们的社团会议在线举行。

application.prompt: The class uses the internet to meet. The class is ___. (online / brightly)
application.solution: online。解析：在线上进行的活动用 online。

grammar: 可数名词，表示羽毛球运动中击打的球；复数形式为 shuttlecocks。
collocations: hit a shuttlecock；a badminton shuttlecock
commonMistake: shuttlecock 指羽毛球运动中被击打的球；运动项目是 badminton。

example.english: The shuttlecock landed beside the net.
example.chinese: 羽毛球落在了球网旁边。

application.prompt: In badminton, players hit a feathered object over the net. It is a ___. (shuttlecock / passenger)
application.solution: shuttlecock。解析：羽毛球运动中击打的球叫 shuttlecock。

grammar: 可数名词可表示值得看的景物；不可数用法 sight 也可表示视力。
collocations: see the sights；a beautiful sight；lose one's sight
commonMistake: 表示“名胜/景点”时常用复数 sights，如 see the sights。

example.english: We saw many famous sights in Nairobi.
example.chinese: 我们在内罗毕看到了许多著名景点。

application.prompt: On a city tour, you visit well-known places. You see the ___. (sights / voices)
application.solution: sights。解析：see the sights 表示游览名胜。

grammar: 可数名词，是 examination 的常用简称；考试可用 take an exam，取得通过结果用 pass an exam。
collocations: take an exam；pass an exam；study for an exam
commonMistake: take an exam 表示参加考试；pass an exam 表示通过考试，不能互换。

example.english: Our English exam starts at nine tomorrow.
example.chinese: 我们的英语考试明天九点开始。

application.prompt: Lily is preparing tonight because she has to ___ an exam tomorrow. (take / make)
application.solution: take。解析：参加考试用 take an exam。

grammar: 可作动词或名词；常用 hope to do sth 或 hope (that) + 从句表达希望。
collocations: hope to see；hope for the best；I hope so
commonMistake: hope 后可接 to do 或从句；表示希望某人做某事时用 hope that sb will/can ...，不说 hope sb to do。

example.english: I hope to see you at the festival.
example.chinese: 我希望在节日庆典上见到你。

application.prompt: Complete the sentence: “We hope ___ the race.” (to join / joining to)
application.solution: to join。解析：hope 后可接动词不定式。

grammar: 副词，表示“向前”；常见搭配 move/step/look forward。
collocations: move forward；step forward；look forward to
commonMistake: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接名词或动词 -ing 形式。

example.english: Please move forward so everyone can see.
example.chinese: 请向前移动，这样每个人都能看见。

application.prompt: The line is moving. Please take one step ___. (forward / brightly)
application.solution: forward。解析：step forward 表示向前迈步。

grammar: 表示“期待、盼望”；to 是介词，后接名词、代词或动词 -ing 形式。
collocations: look forward to a trip；look forward to seeing sb
commonMistake: to 是介词，不定式动词不能直接跟在后面；应说 look forward to seeing，不说 look forward to see。

example.english: I'm looking forward to seeing the boat race.
example.chinese: 我期待着观看划船比赛。

application.prompt: Choose the correct form: “We look forward to ___ you.” (seeing / see)
application.solution: seeing。解析：look forward to 中 to 是介词，后接动词 -ing。

grammar: 动词，表示滑冰或滑旱冰；可说 skate on ice 或 go skating。
collocations: skate on ice；go skating；skate well
commonMistake: 表示进行这项活动常说 go skating；skate 本身作动词时可直接使用。

example.english: The children skate on the ice after school.
example.chinese: 孩子们放学后在冰上滑冰。

application.prompt: In winter, we can ___ on the frozen lake. (skate / shine)
application.solution: skate。解析：在冰面上滑冰用 skate。

grammar: 动词，表示发生；常用 What happened?、happen to sb 或 happen to do sth。
collocations: What happened?；happen to sb；happen by chance
commonMistake: happen 通常不用于被动语态；问“发生了什么”用 What happened?。

example.english: What happened to your phone during the race?
example.chinese: 比赛时你的手机怎么了？

application.prompt: Choose the natural question after finding a broken racket: “What ___?” (happened / was happened)
application.solution: happened。解析：happen 是不及物动词，一般不用被动语态。

grammar: 可数名词，表示区域或地带；常见复合词 time zone。
collocations: time zone；a quiet zone；a safe zone
commonMistake: zone 是可数名词，单数前通常需要冠词或其他限定词。

example.english: This quiet zone is for reading and study.
example.chinese: 这个安静区域供阅读和学习。

application.prompt: A region that uses the same standard time is a time ___. (zone / voice)
application.solution: zone。解析：time zone 表示时区。

grammar: 名词短语，表示时区；说明所在区域可用 in，如 in a different time zone。
collocations: in a time zone；cross time zones；time-zone difference
commonMistake: 表示身处某个时区通常用 in；不要把 time zone 拆写成两个不相关的词义。

example.english: Nairobi is in a different time zone from New York.
example.chinese: 内罗毕和纽约处于不同的时区。

application.prompt: A city lies within one standard-time area. It is ___ a time zone. (in / on)
application.solution: in。解析：表示处于某个区域内用 in。

sources.label: Cambridge Grammar: at, on and in (place)

grammar: 介词短语，表示“世界各地、全世界”；around 在此表示遍及。
collocations: travel around the world；famous around the world
commonMistake: around the world 是固定表达；表示全世界范围一般不在 world 前加 the 以外的冠词。

example.english: People around the world enjoy music festivals.
example.chinese: 世界各地的人们都喜欢音乐节。

application.prompt: Choose the phrase meaning “in many countries everywhere”: ___. (around the world / at the moment)
application.solution: around the world。解析：around the world 表示全世界、世界各地。

grammar: 可作动词或名词；动词表示匆忙赶去，名词可表示匆忙或繁忙时期。
collocations: rush to school；rush hour；in a rush
commonMistake: rush 是动词时可说 rush to a place；不要把 rush hour 当成动词短语。

example.english: We had to rush to the bus stop.
example.chinese: 我们不得不赶去公交车站。

application.prompt: The bus is leaving soon, so we must ___ to the stop. (rush / shine)
application.solution: rush。解析：赶去某地用 rush to。

grammar: 介词短语，表示“匆忙”；可用 be in a hurry to do sth。
collocations: be in a hurry；in a hurry to leave
commonMistake: 固定表达中 a 不能省略；说 in a hurry，不说 in hurry。

example.english: Dad left in a hurry and forgot his phone.
example.chinese: 爸爸匆忙离开，忘了带手机。

application.prompt: She must leave quickly. She is ___ a ___. (in, hurry / at, hurry)
application.solution: in, hurry。解析：固定搭配为 in a hurry。

grammar: 可作动词或名词；动词表示发光、照耀，过去式和过去分词常见为 shone。
collocations: the sun shines；shine brightly；shine a light
commonMistake: 副词修饰动词 shine，如 shine brightly；不要用形容词 bright 直接修饰动词。

example.english: The sun shines brightly over the park.
example.chinese: 阳光明亮地照耀着公园。

application.prompt: The sun gives off light. It ___. (shines / is shiningly)
application.solution: shines。解析：shine 作动词表示发光；一般现在时主语 it 后加 -s。

grammar: 副词，表示明亮地；通常修饰 shine、glow 等表示发光的动词。
collocations: shine brightly；glow brightly
commonMistake: brightly 是副词；修饰名词用形容词 bright，如 a bright light。

example.english: The lights shine brightly on the stage.
example.chinese: 灯光明亮地照在舞台上。

application.prompt: Choose the adverb: “The stars shine ___.” (brightly / bright)
application.solution: brightly。解析：副词修饰动词 shine。

grammar: 形容词，表示色彩鲜艳的；名词 colour 加后缀 -ful 构成。
collocations: colourful clothes；a colourful festival；colourful flowers
commonMistake: colourful 是英式拼写，美式常写 colorful；意思相同。

example.english: The dancers wore colourful clothes at the festival.
example.chinese: 舞者们在节日庆典上穿着色彩鲜艳的衣服。

application.prompt: Complete with the British spelling from the word list: “a ___ boat” (colourful / colorfull)
application.solution: colourful。解析：英式拼写为 colourful，美式拼写为 colorful。

grammar: 副词，表示缓慢地；由形容词 slow 加 -ly 构成。
collocations: walk slowly；speak slowly；move slowly
commonMistake: slowly 是副词，修饰动作；slow 可作形容词，也可在非正式语境作副词。

example.english: Please speak slowly on the phone.
example.chinese: 请在电话里说慢一点。

application.prompt: The connection is poor. Please speak ___. (slowly / slowest)
application.solution: slowly。解析：此处需要副词修饰 speak。

grammar: 可作限定词或代词；常用 such a/an + 形容词 + 单数可数名词，如 such a bright day。
collocations: such a good idea；such fun；such as
commonMistake: 单数可数名词前常用 such a/an + adj. + noun；不要漏掉冠词。

example.english: It was such a bright day for a race.
example.chinese: 那天阳光明媚，很适合比赛。

application.prompt: Choose the correct phrase: “___ colourful festival” (such a / such an)
application.solution: such a。解析：colourful 以辅音音素开头，单数可数名词前用 a。

grammar: 介词短语，表示“例如”；后接名词、代词或动名词列举例子。
collocations: sports such as skating；cities such as Nairobi
commonMistake: such as 后面直接列举例子；列举单个名词时不要再加 like。

example.english: We play sports such as badminton and skating.
example.chinese: 我们进行羽毛球和滑冰等运动。

application.prompt: Complete the example: “I enjoy water sports ___ swimming.” (such as / because)
application.solution: such as。解析：such as 用于举例。

grammar: 可作可数名词，表示一幅画；也可表示绘画这一活动。
collocations: a painting of a park；oil painting；enjoy painting
commonMistake: 一幅画可数，如 a painting；绘画活动常作不可数或动名词理解。

example.english: Beth showed us a painting of Central Park.
example.chinese: 贝丝给我们看了一幅中央公园的画。

application.prompt: There is one finished picture on the wall. It is a ___. (painting / sunshine)
application.solution: painting。解析：一幅画可说 a painting。

examTags: 语法·可数名词与地点介词
grammar: 可数名词，表示市场；常说 go to the market 或 shop at a market。
collocations: a street market；go to the market；market price
commonMistake: go to the market 表示去市场；market 作单数可数名词时通常需要限定词。

example.english: We bought fruit at the market near the subway station.
example.chinese: 我们在地铁站附近的市场买了水果。

application.prompt: They are going to buy vegetables. They are going ___ the market. (to / at)
application.solution: to。解析：表示去市场用 go to the market。

grammar: 可数名词，表示边、侧面；常用 on one side 或 on the side of。
collocations: on the left side；side by side；the side of the road
commonMistake: 表示在某物的一侧常说 on the side of；注意区分 side 与 site。

example.english: The subway entrance is on the other side of the road.
example.chinese: 地铁入口在路的另一边。

application.prompt: The station is across the road, on its opposite ___. (side / voice)
application.solution: side。解析：表示一边或另一边用 side。

grammar: 副词短语，表示并排、并肩；常放在动词后说明动作方式。
collocations: stand side by side；walk side by side
commonMistake: 固定短语是 side by side；不能写成 side to side 来表达并排。

example.english: The two teams stood side by side for a photo.
example.chinese: 两支队伍并排站着拍照。

application.prompt: Two friends walk next to each other, not one behind the other. They walk ___.
application.solution: side by side。解析：并排同行用 side by side。

grammar: 可数名词，美式英语中常指地铁；英式英语中 underground 或 tube 更常见。
collocations: take the subway；a subway station；subway line
commonMistake: subway 在美式英语常指地铁；按语境不要与人行地下通道义混淆。

example.english: We took the subway to Central Park.
example.chinese: 我们乘地铁去了中央公园。

application.prompt: In American English, an underground city train is a ___. (subway / race)
application.solution: subway。解析：美式英语常用 subway 表示地铁。

grammar: 形容词，可表示明亮的、鲜艳的或聪明的；修饰名词。
collocations: bright light；bright colours；a bright student
commonMistake: bright 是形容词；修饰动词 shine 时用副词 brightly。

example.english: The bright lights made the market easy to see.
example.chinese: 明亮的灯光让市场清晰可见。

application.prompt: Choose the adjective: “a ___ light” (bright / brightly)
application.solution: bright。解析：修饰名词 light 需要形容词。

grammar: 可作动词或名词；动词可表示掉落、使落下或下降；过去式和过去分词为 dropped。
collocations: drop a phone；drop the price；a drop of water
commonMistake: drop 的过去式需双写 p 再加 -ed：dropped。

example.english: Be careful not to drop your phone on the subway.
example.chinese: 小心别把手机掉在地铁上。

application.prompt: The temperature went down yesterday. It ___. (dropped / droped)
application.solution: dropped。解析：drop 变过去式时双写 p 再加 -ed。

grammar: 短语动词，按本课义表示开车送某人到某处；宾语为代词时放在 drop 与 off 之间。
collocations: drop sb off at school；drop me off；drop off a passenger
commonMistake: 代词宾语放中间，说 drop her off，不说 drop off her。

example.english: Could you drop me off at the station?
example.chinese: 你能把我送到车站吗？

application.prompt: Put the pronoun in the correct place: “drop off them at the park” → ___
application.solution: drop them off at the park。解析：可分短语动词后接代词时，代词放在中间。

grammar: 可数名词，表示乘客；复数为 passengers。
collocations: bus passenger；train passenger；passenger seat
commonMistake: passenger 指乘坐交通工具的人；驾驶车辆的人是 driver。

example.english: Every passenger must wear a seat belt.
example.chinese: 每位乘客都必须系好安全带。

application.prompt: A person riding on a bus, but not driving it, is a ___. (passenger / driver)
application.solution: passenger。解析：乘客是 passenger，驾驶员是 driver。

grammar: 形容词，表示中心的、中央的；通常放在名词前作定语。
collocations: central station；central location；central London
commonMistake: central 是形容词；表示“中心”这个名词时用 centre（英）或 center（美）。

example.english: The hotel is in a central part of Nairobi.
example.chinese: 这家酒店位于内罗毕的中心区域。

application.prompt: Choose the adjective: “a ___ station” (central / centre)
application.solution: central。解析：修饰名词 station 要用形容词 central。

grammar: 动词，表示解释、说明；常用 explain sth to sb 或 explain that 从句。
collocations: explain a rule；explain sth to sb；explain why
commonMistake: 说 explain the rule to me；不说 explain me the rule。

example.english: Could you explain the bus route to me?
example.chinese: 你能给我讲讲这条公交线路吗？

application.prompt: Choose the correct order: “Please explain the map ___ us.” (to / for)
application.solution: to。解析：explain sth to sb 表示向某人解释某事。

grammar: 动词短语，表示参加某项活动；in 后接名词或动名词。
collocations: take part in a race；take part in a festival
commonMistake: 固定搭配为 take part in；不要遗漏介词 in。

example.english: Our class will take part in the school race.
example.chinese: 我们班将参加学校的比赛。

application.prompt: Mia joins the festival parade. She will ___ the parade. (take part in / take part to)
application.solution: take part in。解析：表示参加活动用 take part in。

grammar: 可作名词或动词；名词表示旅行、参观行程，动词表示游览。
collocations: a city tour；go on a tour；tour the city
commonMistake: 表示参加一次旅行常说 go on a tour；tour 作动词时后可直接接地点。

example.english: We went on a tour of New York by bus.
example.chinese: 我们乘公交游览了纽约。

application.prompt: The guide is showing visitors around the city. The group is on a city ___. (tour / message)
application.solution: tour。解析：城市观光行程是 city tour。

grammar: 不可数名词，表示阳光；通常不与 a/an 连用。
collocations: bright sunshine；in the sunshine；warm sunshine
commonMistake: sunshine 通常不可数；说 some sunshine 或 bright sunshine，不说 a sunshine。

example.english: We enjoyed the warm sunshine in the park.
example.chinese: 我们在公园里享受温暖的阳光。

application.prompt: Choose the natural phrase: “We sat in ___.” (the sunshine / a sunshine)
application.solution: the sunshine。解析：sunshine 通常是不可数名词，不能用 a 修饰。

grammar: 动词，表示开车、驾驶；过去式 drove，过去分词 driven。
collocations: drive a car；drive to school；drive carefully
commonMistake: drive 的过去式是 drove，不是 drived；乘客乘车通常用 ride。

example.english: My aunt drives to work before rush hour.
example.chinese: 我阿姨在交通高峰前开车去上班。

application.prompt: Yesterday Dad ___ us to the festival. (drove / drived)
application.solution: drove。解析：drive 的过去式为 drove。

grammar: 名词短语，表示上下班交通高峰时段；常用 at rush hour 或 during rush hour。
collocations: during rush hour；the morning rush hour
commonMistake: 常说 at rush hour 或 during rush hour；具体语境中也可说 the rush hour。

example.english: The subway is crowded during rush hour.
example.chinese: 交通高峰时段地铁很拥挤。

application.prompt: The roads are busiest when people travel to and from work. This is ___. (rush hour / free time)
application.solution: rush hour。解析：上下班交通高峰时段叫 rush hour。

grammar: 专有地名，两个词均首字母大写；表示在纽约通常说 in New York。
collocations: in New York；New York City；New York subway
commonMistake: New York 是专有名词，两个单词都要大写；不要把 New 写成小写。

example.english: My cousin lives in New York.
example.chinese: 我表哥住在纽约。

application.prompt: Choose the correctly written city name: (New York / new york)
application.solution: New York。解析：专有地名首字母大写。

grammar: 国家专有名词，首字母大写；表示在肯尼亚通常用 in Kenya。
collocations: in Kenya；Kenyan people；Kenya's capital
commonMistake: 国家名称 Kenya 首字母必须大写；表示在某国用 in，不用 at。

example.english: Nairobi is the capital of Kenya.
example.chinese: 内罗毕是肯尼亚的首都。

application.prompt: Choose the correct preposition: “She lives ___ Kenya.” (in / on)
application.solution: in。解析：表示在国家境内通常用 in。

grammar: United States of America 的缩写；作国家名称时常写 the USA。
collocations: the USA；in the USA；the United States
commonMistake: USA 通常与定冠词 the 连用；缩写字母全部大写。

example.english: My uncle lives in the USA.
example.chinese: 我叔叔住在美国。

application.prompt: Complete the country name: “She studies in ___.” (the USA / a USA)
application.solution: the USA。解析：USA 作国名时通常用 the。

grammar: 纽约市公园的专有名称，两个词首字母大写；地点前通常用 in。
collocations: in Central Park；visit Central Park
commonMistake: 专有地名 Central Park 两个词首字母都要大写。

example.english: We walked in Central Park after lunch.
example.chinese: 午饭后我们在中央公园散步。

application.prompt: Choose the correctly written place name: (Central Park / central park)
application.solution: Central Park。解析：专有名称中的两个词均首字母大写。

sources.label: Central Park Conservancy: About the Park

grammar: 男性名字，首字母大写；作句子主语时谓语按第三人称单数变化。
collocations: Adam's phone；Adam is calling
commonMistake: 人名 Adam 首字母大写；Adam 作单数主语时一般现在时动词加 -s。

example.english: Adam is waiting for the bus outside.
example.chinese: 亚当正在外面等公交车。

application.prompt: Choose the correct form: “Adam ___ online now.” (is / are)
application.solution: is。解析：Adam 是单数人名，be 动词用 is。

grammar: 中国传统节日的英文名称，主要单词首字母大写；说节日期间可用 during the Dragon Boat Festival。
collocations: the Dragon Boat Festival；celebrate the Dragon Boat Festival
commonMistake: 节日名称中的主要单词首字母大写；完整表达中常用 the Dragon Boat Festival。

example.english: Our family watches boat races during the Dragon Boat Festival.
example.chinese: 端午节期间，我们一家会观看赛龙舟。

application.prompt: Choose the correctly capitalized festival: (Dragon Boat Festival / dragon boat festival)
application.solution: Dragon Boat Festival。解析：专有节日名称中的主要单词首字母大写。

sources.label: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage: Dragon Boat festival

grammar: 女性名字，首字母大写；作句子主语时谓语按第三人称单数变化。
collocations: Beth's message；Beth is online
commonMistake: 人名 Beth 首字母大写；表示“贝丝的”可写 Beth's。

example.english: Beth is waiting at the subway station.
example.chinese: 贝丝正在地铁站等候。

application.prompt: Complete the sentence: “___ is calling you back.” (Beth / beth)
application.solution: Beth。解析：句首人名首字母大写。

examTags: 语法·专有名词与地点介词
grammar: 肯尼亚首都的专有名称，首字母大写；表示在城市中通常用 in。
collocations: in Nairobi；Nairobi, Kenya；Nairobi city centre
commonMistake: 城市名称 Nairobi 首字母大写；表示在某城市通常用 in。

example.english: My aunt works in Nairobi.
example.chinese: 我姑姑在内罗毕工作。

application.prompt: Choose the correct preposition: “The festival is ___ Nairobi.” (in / at)
application.solution: in。解析：表示活动在城市范围内举行通常用 in。
